hint: tap anywhere to top up the pot

game.q: the pot’s too heavy. why wave a friend over instead of calling out?
opts: “they didn’t break their silence for chores”

wrong.shy: they talked every fifth night. not shy.

game.right: YES. no chatter over a water pot. small chores, done quietly, kept their minds free.

end.line: three monks kept a forest at peace, one water pot at a time.
end.l2: whoever saw it empty filled it.

cliff.s2: stretches his own body across a river so his troop can cross.

share: three monks, one forest, zero fights. the story on infinite hill
